question: What is the closest synonym of “rigid” as used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. Fixed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“rigid”** in the context of the passage refers to educational models that are strict, inflexible, or unchanging. (Rigid का अर्थ है - कठोर, स्थिर या जड़।)
 
• **“Fixed”** means something that does not change or adapt, which is the closest synonym to “rigid” in this context. (Fixed का अर्थ है - स्थिर, जो बदलता नहीं है।)
 
• Other options like adaptable, elastic, and open are antonyms of rigid.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Fixed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adaptable** (अनुकूलनीय): Means able to change or adjust; the opposite of rigid.
 
• **Elastic** (लचीला): Means flexible or stretchable; also the opposite of rigid.
 
• **Open** (खुला): Means receptive or willing to consider; also opposite of rigid in this context.

43:Tcd2,

The correct answer is **Option 2**.
